hook.name: ThryxAntiSniperHookV5
hook.description: An anti-sniper hook for token launches that applies a time-decaying fee (up to 80% at t=0, decaying over a configurable window to a permanent 1% base) on exact-input swaps, with fees split between pool creators and the protocol. Supports per-pool parameter overrides, a block-multiplier surcharge for rapid sequential swaps, and an optional agent credential bypass via signed hookData.
